set.body: Implement the first admitted statistical specialization: the complete fixed-metric equal-partition covariance of crossvalidated distances, with exact diagonal, selected-entry, apply, quadratic-form, transport, and size-preflighted materialize operations. Acceptance: Eq. 10/all-pairs equivalence, Eq. 13 full-matrix oracle agreement, direct-query/materialization equivalence, bounded execution, and no dense fourth-order lift.
set.title: Epic B: Implement fixed-metric analytic covariance transport
